code.zh-CN: 是否被 code 元素包裹。
code.en-US: Whether the text is wrapped in a code element.

component.zh-CN: 自定义渲染元素，可以是标签名或 Vue 组件，默认 span。
component.en-US: Element to render: a tag name or a Vue component. Defaults to span.

copyable.zh-CN: 是否可复制；传对象时见 Copyable Config。
copyable.en-US: Whether the text can be copied; pass an object for the Copyable Config.

ellipsis.zh-CN: 设置自动溢出省略；传对象时见 Ellipsis Config。
ellipsis.en-US: Truncates overflowing text; pass an object for the Ellipsis Config.

link.zh-CN: 是否为链接；传对象时，其中的属性（href、target、class、style、onClick 等）挂在 a 元素上。
link.en-US: Whether the text is a link; with an object, its attributes (href, target, class, style, onClick and so on) are applied to the a element.

size.zh-CN: 文本大小，inherit 继承外层 Text 或 Paragraph 的尺寸。
size.en-US: Text size; inherit takes the size of the enclosing Text or Paragraph.

copy.zh-CN: 复制后触发，参数为点击事件、复制的内容和是否写入成功；写入被拒绝时为 false，此时不进入已复制状态。
copy.en-US: Emitted after copying, with the click event, the copied content and whether the write succeeded. When the write is rejected it is false and the copied state is not entered.

expand.zh-CN: 点击展开或收起控件时触发，参数为操作之后的展开状态和点击事件。
expand.en-US: Emitted when the expand or collapse control is clicked, with the expanded state after the action and the click event.

icon.zh-CN: 前缀图标；Semi 图标按 size 自动设为 small 或 default。
icon.en-US: Prefix icon; a Semi icon is set to small or default according to size.

copyIcon.zh-CN: 复制按钮的内容；内容为单个节点且带 aria-label 时以它作为按钮的可访问名称，否则用语言包的「复制」。
copyIcon.en-US: Content of the copy button; a single node with an aria-label names the button, otherwise the locale's "Copy" does.

copyTip.en-US: Tooltip content of the copy button.

copySuccessTip.zh-CN: 复制成功后的展示内容。
copySuccessTip.en-US: Content shown after a successful copy.

copyAction.zh-CN: 完全自定义复制节点，参数为 copied、copy 和解析后的 config。
copyAction.en-US: Replaces the whole copy node; receives copied, copy and the resolved config.

ellipsisContent.zh-CN: 截断时浮层中的内容，默认是全文。
ellipsisContent.en-US: Content of the floating layer when truncated; defaults to the full text.

ellipsisTooltip.zh-CN: 自定义浮层，仅在文本溢出时渲染；参数 content 是全文，trigger 是文字元素，用 `<component :is="trigger" />` 放入自己的浮层。
ellipsisTooltip.en-US: Custom floating layer, rendered only when the text overflows; content is the full text and trigger is the text element, to be placed in your own layer with `<component :is="trigger" />`.

component.zh-CN: 自定义渲染元素，可以是标签名或 Vue 组件，默认由 heading 决定（h1 到 h6）。
component.en-US: Element to render: a tag name or a Vue component. Defaults to h1 to h6 by heading.

copyable.en-US: Whether the text can be copied; pass an object for the Copyable Config.

ellipsis.zh-CN: 设置自动溢出省略；传对象时见 Ellipsis Config。
ellipsis.en-US: Truncates overflowing text; pass an object for the Ellipsis Config.

heading.zh-CN: 标题级别，对应 h1 到 h6。
heading.en-US: Heading level, matching h1 to h6.

weight.en-US: Font weight: light, regular, medium, semibold, bold, default, or a number.

precision.en-US: Number of decimal places to keep.

rule.zh-CN: 解析规则：text 仅取整，numbers 过滤非数字字符，bytes-decimal、bytes-binary 换算字节单位，percentages 转百分比，exponential 转科学计数法。
rule.en-US: Parsing rule: text only rounds, numbers filters out non-numeric characters, bytes-decimal and bytes-binary convert byte units, percentages converts to percent, exponential converts to scientific notation.

size.zh-CN: 文本大小，inherit 继承外层 Text 或 Paragraph 的尺寸。
size.en-US: Text size; inherit takes the size of the enclosing Text or Paragraph.

truncate.zh-CN: 小数点后保留位的取整方式，对应 Math.round、Math.ceil、Math.floor。
truncate.en-US: How the kept decimals are rounded, matching Math.round, Math.ceil and Math.floor.

default.zh-CN: 要格式化的内容；递归处理其中的文本与元素，不处理组件内部的文字。
default.en-US: Content to format; text and elements are processed recursively, text inside components is not.

icon.en-US: Prefix icon; a Semi icon is set to small or default according to size.
